categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Feymer Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the hydrophilic functional polymers sector, serving water-based industries such as pulp and paper, water treatment, mineral processing, oil and gas extraction, and textile dyeing. Its main product lines include functional monomers, water-soluble polymers, water treatment membrane products and applications, and energy supply services. The company also engages in research and development, production, and sales of chemical raw materials and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in functional monomer synthesis, water-soluble polymer manufacturing, and membrane production, including proprietary microbial fermentation catalysts, continuous tubular reactors, and membrane casting techniques. It has developed 22 core technologies covering monomer production, polymer synthesis, membrane materials, membrane applications, and hydrogen production. The firm emphasizes precise molecular design, polymerization control, and application-specific product customization, supported by a strong patent portfolio and participation in national standards development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial users in pulp and paper manufacturing, municipal and industrial water treatment, mineral processing, oil and gas fields, and textile dyeing sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a growing export footprint in Southeast Asia, Russia, and other regions. It targets large-scale industrial clients requiring specialized polymer products and membrane solutions for green and sustainable industrial processes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangsu (Zhangjiagang, Suzhou), Anhui (Anqing), and other locations. It actively expands its international presence, focusing on Southeast Asia, Russia, and Middle East energy clusters. Its export business has grown by 7.91% despite global economic challenges, supported by localized service centers and remote diagnostic systems.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Feymer Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It produces key raw materials (functional monomers) and intermediate products (water-soluble polymers) and manufactures membrane products, supplying these to industrial end-users. The company also provides application technology services and energy supply to industrial parks, integrating upstream raw material sourcing with downstream product delivery and technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green technology innovation aligned with national carbon neutrality goals, focusing on developing high-performance, environmentally friendly hydrophilic polymers and membrane technologies. It invests heavily in R&D to improve product quality, stability, and cost efficiency, and expands applications into new fields such as semiconductor materials, battery separators, and ecological restoration. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are key strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of functional monomers, water-soluble polymers, membrane products, and energy supply services. The company employs a direct sales model for large customers with integrated product and technical service offerings, supplemented by distributor sales for smaller clients. It also earns income from water treatment membrane application services and project-based membrane equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with multinational chemical firms such as Ashland, Solenis, and Kemira in the water treatment chemicals market. It holds a leading position domestically in cationic polyacrylamide products for paper making and ranks among the top five in the industry for cationic polyacrylamide. In membrane technology, it is a newer entrant but is rapidly developing capabilities to compete with established international membrane manufacturers. The firm is recognized as a technology leader in China’s hydrophilic functional polymer industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.57 billion, a 4.54% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to intensified downstream competition and raw material price declines. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 4.65 million, impacted by lower revenues, increased depreciation from new projects, and higher interest expenses. Total assets grew 8.43% to RMB 2.7 billion, while net assets decreased 6.72% to RMB 1.41 billion. The company continues to invest in capacity expansion and digital transformation to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Feymer Technology emphasizes its green technology mission to protect water resources by providing high-quality, high-purity hydrophilic functional polymers and membrane products tailored to complex industrial water processes. Its competitive edge lies in integrated product-application-technology-service solutions, extensive patent portfolio, and deep understanding of customer-specific water treatment challenges. The company’s vertical integration from monomer production to polymer synthesis and membrane application enhances supply stability and cost control, supporting sustainable industrial development.
